scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the correctness of each α and γ entry by comparing the agent's computed values to the paper's Table 1 gold using a 5% relative tolerance. A monotonic trend check adds a secondary structural component. This is effectively a T1 recompute, as the metric is derived from the raw artifact, not trusted from a self-report.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold α and γ values for CdF₂ and PbF₂ at 300–650 K from Table 1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 of Pramana – J. Phys. (1987), doi:10.1007/bf02845838
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numbers the paper reports; using them as hidden gold ensures the reproduction target matches the original experiment.

outputs.description: Scored reproduction of the coefficient of thermal expansion α and Grüneisen parameter γ for CdF₂ and β‑PbF₂ at temperatures 300–650 K. Values are compared against reference values derived from the same physical protocol within a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the alpha_gamma CSV is scored. The auxiliary quantities CSV is an intermediate evidence file and is not part of the output contract.

steps.description: Compare each (Material,Temperature) α and γ to the paper's Table 1 values within 5% relative tolerance and verify monotonic trends.
